The '''Kitaros Nebula''' was a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] that was located in the [[Prefsbelt sector/Legends|Prefsbelt sector]], within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] regions of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="New Territories" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kitaros Nebula was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the nebula in grid square K-5.<ref name="EAOC" />
